name: Cymatic Chladni sand
doc: GPU particle simulation of vibrating Chladni and cymatic sand grains driven by the picked media and musical pitch: grains inherit the picture's colours, bounce out of acoustic antinodes, gather along both the picture's edge contours and pitch-selected standing-wave nodal lines, jolt on onsets, and re-form the live picture at phrase turns.

in.doc: source media image or video whose colours tint the sand grains and vibrating plate

luma.doc: media brightness (e.g. core-media.luma) warping plate thickness and nodal curvature

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) forming acoustic valleys where sand gathers

palette.doc: accent palette for vibrating grain sparkles, nodal highlights and plate sheen

mode.doc: standing-wave plate geometry: square Chladni plate, circular cymatic dish, or travelling acoustic edge dunes

chladni.doc: strength of pitch-driven Chladni nodal line attraction and antinode vibration

edge_pull.doc: how strongly sand grains gather into the picture's edge contours

luma_warp.doc: how much picture brightness bends the standing-wave pattern around the subject

vibrate.doc: antinode acoustic bounce and bass-driven grain agitation

jolt.doc: onset scatter impulse that launches grains into sparkling arcs

reform.doc: how cleanly sand grains re-gather into the live picture at phrase boundaries

size.doc: sand grain radius in pixels at 1080p

streak.doc: velocity motion streak on fast-bouncing grains

under.doc: embossed vibrating picture plate visible beneath the sand

pal_mix.doc: palette metallic/neon accent on agitated grains and nodal sheen

changelog.note: first version: GPU particle Chladni & cymatic sand simulation coupling pitch-driven standing waves with media edge contours
